summary: Iteration 13: admin bike photo upload (POST /api/admin/upload + public GET /api/files/{id}) + frontend PhotoPicker + imageUri() prefixing — all green. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_upload.py (9 tests, 9/9 PASSED in 2.4s): (1) POST /api/admin/upload returns 401 without token; (2) 403 for a normal user_token; (3) 400 for text/plain with Italian detail; (4) 413 for a 10MB+1-byte image/png blob; (5) 200 for a 73-byte real PNG — response body = {url:'/api/files/{32-hex-id}'}; (6) GET /api/files/{id} returns 200, Content-Type: image/png, body bytes BYTE-IDENTICAL to the uploaded PNG; (7) same roundtrip for a hand-crafted real 1x1 JPEG → 200 image/jpeg; (8) GET /api/files/{random uuid4} returns 404; (9) end-to-end admin flow: upload PNG → POST /api/admin/bikes with image_url='/api/files/..' (name=TEST_IT13_bike_xxxxx, category=gravel, price_day=10, stock={S:1}) → verify the bike appears in GET /api/bikes with correct image_url → fetch the image URL as an anonymous session (no auth) and verify 200 + identical bytes → DELETE /api/admin/bikes/{id} (cleanup). Note: Cache-Control from backend ('public, max-age=31536000, immutable') is REWRITTEN by Cloudflare in the preview env to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on all /api responses (verified via curl on both an unknown-id 405/404 and a valid 200 file). The backend contract itself (server.py:646) is correct; the production CDN config will carry the long cache. FRONTEND (390x844, admin admin@noleggionuovo.it/Admin2026!): login via testIDs login-email-input + login-password-input + login-submit-button → navigated to /admin/bike-form (new) → verified both PhotoPicker buttons render with Italian labels: testID bike-form-photo-camera ('\uf1db Scatta foto', ionicon-camera + text) and bike-form-photo-library ('\uf391 Dalla galleria', ionicon-images + text). Section label 'Foto della bici' present. Scrolled the library button into center-view, clicked with force=True, Playwright caught the file chooser event (expo-image-picker creates a hidden on web and clicks it), set files to a locally generated 8x8 PNG (73 bytes). Within ~5s: toast 'Foto caricata' visible in the DOM, testID bike-form-image field value = '/api/files/804c2a31eacb4106808e7811306bccfb', preview src = 'https://bici-disponibili.preview.emergentagent.com/api/files/804c2a31eacb4106808e7811306bccfb' (confirms imageUri() prefix is applied), fetch() of that URL from the page returns [200, 'image/png']. Did NOT tap bike-form-save in the UI (per safety contract: real fleet protection); the equivalent flow was fully verified at the API layer in test (9). REGRESSION (390x844, unauthenticated): Home catalog cards render 4 external imgix https URLs intact (Raymon Soreno/Norza/Vamok, Focus logo) + the uploaded /api/files/.. URL present in the uploaded form screenshot. Opened first card → /bike/{id} detail page shows the external raymon.imgix.net image + full specs block (Carbonio MLC, Shimano GRX 1x12, 160 mm, 28\" Maxxis Reaver 45 mm, 10.2 kg) — no breakage introduced by imageUri(). Checkout flow not entered (would require starting a booking against real stock; skipping per safety contract — checkout thumbnail code path uses the same imageUri() helper and is covered by inspection: /app/frontend/src/api.ts:17-19 returns `${BACKEND_URL}${url}` for anything starting with '/api/' and the original string otherwise, so both uploaded and external URLs render correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: server.admin_upload_photo (server.py:607-631): clean implementation — Content-Type whitelist (IMAGE_TYPES covers jpg/jpeg/png/webp/heic/heif), empty-file guard (400 'File vuoto'), 10 MB limit (413 'Foto troppo grande'), unique path '{APP_NAME}/bikes/{uuid4_hex}.{ext}', inserts a 'files' doc with owner_id/public:true/is_deleted:false/created_at. 402 passthrough from storage ('Spazio di archiviazione esaurito') is a nice user-facing hint. One minor consideration: the full file body is read into memory (data = await file.read()) BEFORE the size check — a hostile 500 MB upload would still allocate 500 MB RSS on the pod before the 413 is returned. For a tiny admin-only endpoint this is acceptable; if ever exposed more widely consider streaming the UploadFile and short-circuiting at MAX_PHOTO_BYTES. Not a blocker.

server.get_file (server.py:634-646): correctly filters public:true + is_deleted:false, uses stored content_type (falls back to the one storage returned), sets long cache header. Response is served via a FastAPI Response(content=bytes) which loads the full file in memory per request — again fine for small bike photos; for larger media use StreamingResponse. Note: Cloudflare in the preview env overrides the Cache-Control on /api/* responses to no-store/no-cache/must-revalidate; this is an infra concern, backend is correct.

storage.py: idempotent init via module-level _storage_key cache + 503-triggered single retry. STORAGE_BASE falls back to https://integrations.emergentagent.com when INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL is empty/missing — this correctly handles the platform setting the env var to an empty string. Clean.

PhotoPicker.tsx:14-44: ensurePermission branches on Platform.OS==='web' and short-circuits to true, correct for the web preview. Native code requests camera/library perms via expo-image-picker, respects canAskAgain, offers an 'Open Settings' deep link on permanent denial. Nicely scoped to not block the rest of the form. Not reachable from web Playwright so untested here — flagged for native testing only (noted in iter 'next_testing_agent' context).

PhotoPicker.tsx:51-73: uses uploadForm (/app/frontend/src/utils/upload.ts) which correctly uses expo/fetch for native and strips the default Content-Type so the multipart boundary is set by the runtime. Reads res.text() then parses — handles both success JSON ({url}) and error JSON ({detail}) uniformly. Toasts localised via t('photo_uploaded')/t('upload_failed'). Loading state tracked per-source (camera vs library) so only the clicked button spins. Clean.

api.ts:17-19 imageUri(url): simple and correct — prefixes BACKEND_URL only when url starts with '/api/'. External https URLs are returned unchanged → existing bikes still render. Verified on Home + Detail against the live Raymon imgix URLs.

bike-form.tsx:197 wires PhotoPicker.onUploaded directly to setImageUrl, so the inline testID bike-form-image TextInput reflects the uploaded path immediately. The preview <Image source={{ uri: imageUri(imageUrl) }}/> at line 125 then renders the backend-prefixed URL — verified in the browser screenshot and via a live fetch (200 image/png).

Minor: in test_iter13_upload.py I had to override the session's default Content-Type: application/json to None for multipart uploads (_up_headers helper). Not an app issue, just a test-fixture friction worth noting for the next agent.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and delete their own data: (a) TEST_IT13_bike_<6hex> created with /api/admin/bikes referencing an uploaded /api/files/..; deleted at end of the test via DELETE /api/admin/bikes/{id}. (b) Several /api/files/.. entries uploaded by the test will remain in storage (admin photos; the schema has no automatic cleanup when the bike is deleted) — this is acceptable per spec (orphan photos cost ~73 bytes each; no PII). Session-scoped TEST_user_<uuid> registered via conftest.user_token for the 403 test (no bookings created). Real fleet (Raymon Soreno/Norza/Vamok, Focus Sam 6.9) only READ; no PUT/POST against them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run with: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter13_upload.py -v -p xdist -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter13.xml` (~3s). CRITICAL fixture note: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py's `api` session has default Content-Type: application/json; for multipart uploads you MUST override it with headers={'Content-Type': None, 'Authorization': ...} (see _up_headers in test_iter13_upload.py). For the UI, the file chooser only fires on the SECOND try if the library button is below the fold — always `element.scrollIntoView({block:'center'})` via page.evaluate() first, then wrap the click in `async with page.expect_file_chooser()`. The 'Foto caricata' toast appears for ~3s so capture it within the 5s poll window. On the preview env, Cloudflare rewrites Cache-Control on /api responses to no-store/no-cache/must-revalidate — don't fail the test on that header. Camera button cannot be tested on web (expo-image-picker.launchCameraAsync is unsupported in the browser preview); only verify the testID bike-form-photo-camera renders with label 'Scatta foto'. Admin login testIDs: login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (NOT login-email / login-password). Login endpoint lives at /login (not /auth/login). SAFETY contract (unchanged): never POST /api/bookings with payment_method=store, never mark a stripe booking paid, never Save changes to the 4 real bikes in the admin UI — those write to the user's real Google Sheet.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all specified behaviours work. During test authoring the first run returned 422 'Field required' on uploads because requests.Session.headers set Content-Type: application/json by default, blocking requests from auto-generating the multipart boundary. Fixed in-test by passing Content-Type: None in headers for upload calls (test-only concern; backend is correct).
